description: The first free, scriptable, agent-native CLI for Bahrain's commercial registry — with a local store, ownership-graph traversal, and change-diffing no other tool has.

tools.name: cr_detail
tools.description: Full company profile: capital, shareholders, board, signatories, address, activities, amendment history, branches. Required: CR_NO, BRANCH_NO. Returns the new CompanyDetail.

tools.name: cr_search
tools.description: Search commercial registrations by name (EN/AR), CR number, status, type, sector, activity, partner, nationality, municipality, address, or registration date. Optional: CR_LNM, CR_ANM, CR_NO (plus 1 more). Returns array of CompanyRow.
